About Sociapi

What is Sociapi Society?+

A student-led technology community connecting campuses, practical learning, events, projects, and leadership across Pakistan.

Membership

Who can join Sociapi Society?+

Students interested in technology, design, media, events, and community leadership can apply.

Do I need coding experience?+

No. Existing programs support students at different experience levels.

Campus Chapters

How do I start a chapter?+

Use the campus chapter application. The form opens externally and collects the details needed by the team.

Events & Programs

What are MEHFIL AI and AGENTUM?+

They are Sociapi flagship student events focused on practical technology, careers, and community.

Certificates

How do I verify a certificate?+

Enter the certificate ID printed on the certificate or open its QR verification link.

Partnerships

Can organizations partner with Sociapi?+

Yes. Sociapi works with event, learning, university, and community partners through its partnership process.

Shop

How does checkout work?+

Add merchandise to your cart, enter delivery details, and submit the order. Orders are saved through the existing Sociapi order system.

General Questions

How can I contact Sociapi?+

Use the contact form, email sociapisociety@gmail.com, call +92 332 9984490, or contact the team on WhatsApp.
